limits: Scripted rehearsal only; no natural actor outcome conclusion.
MemStore and HashingEmbedder are reference plumbing, not semantic retrieval quality.
Synthetic authored inputs have identical phase scope across conditions; their authoring quality and natural cost are uncontrolled.
Task effects are deterministic simulations, not real application performance.
Obsolete workaround metrics are action proxies, not proof that a memory caused behavior.
Full logs produced by the --rehearse --json command contain private assessment data and must not enter actor context.
